typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		PGROSS as double,
		PCLASS as string,
		PSUBCL as string,
		PRECID as string,
		PEXCH as string,
		PCARD as string,
		PCALC as string,
		PQTY as double,
		PFIRM as string,
		POFFIC as string,
		PACCT as string,
		PGIVIO as string,
		PGIVF as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 sink(input(
		PEXCH as string,
		PCALC as string,
		PQTY as double,
		POFFIC as string,
		PSUBCL as string,
		PGROSS as double,
		PCARD as string,
		PFIRM as string,
		PACCT as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PRECID as string,
		PCLASS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 5000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PEXCH,
		PCALC,
		PQTY,
		POFFIC,
		PSUBCL,
		PGROSS,
		PCARD,
		PFIRM,
		PACCT,
		EFFDATE,
		loadDate,
		PRECID,
		PCLASS),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
